section_header: BODY ELECTRICAL SYSTEM — Wipers and Washers
title: INSPECT THAT MOTOR OPERATES STOPPING AT STOP POSITION

content.description: Wiper motor wiring diagram showing initial test configuration with battery connected to terminal 3 positive and motor body negative

content.text: 2. INSPECT THAT MOTOR OPERATES STOPPING AT STOP POSITION

items: (a) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 3. Connect the negative (—) lead to the motor body. Operates the motor.
(b) Stop motor operation anywhere except stop position by disconnecting terminal 3.

content.description: Wiper motor wiring diagram showing second test configuration with battery connected to terminal 1 positive and terminals 3 and 4 connected

items: (d) Connect the positive (+) lead from the battery to terminal 1.
(e) Check that the motor stops running at stop position after the motor operates again.

content.text: If operation is not as specified, replace the motor.
